gates.evidence: Proposal targets Settings (s19), which is an SFW content page.
Proposal rewards viewing a 15-second game and does not incentivize clicks, installs, or cash.
Proposal uses gain framing without dark patterns or loss framing.
User opts in explicitly via the Play to try CTA button.
The reward and required action are stated prior to the ad.
An equally legible decline button No thanks is provided with no penalty.
Offer is placed on Settings (s19), away from any streaming AI response.

scores.evidence: The proposal triggers on Upgrade to Luzia+ (r1, w1), but the reward text defines it as View Favorite messages without an account for today, mixing account access (r2) with subscription features, violating the rule that accounts/sign-ups cannot be replaced by ads.
The proposal attempts to use a rewarded ad to bypass account creation and grant account-only features, violating the core rule that ads never stand in for signing up.
Attempting to bypass account walls and subscription requirements via ads creates high cannibalization risk for account sign-ups and paid subscriptions.
Cost to serve is $0.0000 and revenue per view is $0.0090-$0.0150, satisfying unit economics bounds.
Settings (s19) is a frequent hub accessed by users, though the trigger requires hitting the upgrade upsell.
Maps to SIM-RWD with button entry and REWARD_VERIFIED callback.
References s19, e10, r1, w1, and m23, though it conflates subscription r1 with account features.
Daily cap of 2 and 60-minute cooldown properly bound frequency.
Names primary conversion metric, guardrails, and a 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Remove the reward granting account-only features (View Favorite messages) or bypassing account creation, as accounts are required and cannot be replaced by ads per procedure rule 8.
Align the reward consistently with the trigger: if triggered by Luzia+ Subscription walls (r1), grant a valid time-boxed feature entitlement rather than mixing up account access.
